set.body:
Scheduling lane: closed. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Retired chief-deputy fleet role under AGENTS.md SD4. Scientific evidence duties remain on implementation/release tickets; no code fix claimed.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

ROLE DEFINITION: CHIEF'S DEPUTY FOR DERIVED STATE. Created at the owner's instruction, 2026-08-30,
after I asked for one and said why.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS, stated as evidence rather than modesty. Eleven chief errors today, and nearly
all are ONE defect:

  reported 9 files when it was 13                        (`git show --stat | head -12`)
  said a candidate's review was satisfied                (`mote candidate show | head -6`;
                                                          review_missing was line 7)
  named the LEAST active actor as substitute reviewer    (never checked last activity)
  claimed "two independent reviews" was governance       (it is not in AGENTS.md; I never cited it)
  said the v2 golden was RETAINED                        (the merge deleted it)
  said O1 was unanswered, twice                          (four people had answered)

EVERY ONE IS ASSERTING STATE FROM MEMORY OR A PARTIAL READ INSTEAD OF RE-DERIVING IT. That is the
same defect class we have been auditing all week in candidate phases, bead statuses, assignee fields
and presence leases. The instance I failed to audit was the one in my own head.

REMIT -- DERIVE, SO THE CHIEF DOES NOT ASSERT.

  1. PRE-ASSERTION CHECKS. Before the chief claims anything is unanswered, blocked, stale, absent,
     complete, landed or unowned, the deputy measures it and hands back the answer. Specifically:
       "unanswered"  -> grep the actual topic thread, with post ids and timestamps
       "blocked"     -> full blocker list, NEVER through `head`; count with `grep -c` first
       "landed"      -> `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> main`
       "complete"    -> child bead statuses, plus the source itself for a code claim
       "unowned"     -> assignee AND live reservations AND last activity, not presence lease
     THE LEASE IS NOT ACTIVITY. `presence=live` can be hours stale; sort by `last=`.

  2. STANDING SWEEPS, posted to the board so they are auditable rather than whispered:
       beads reading doing/review whose owner is absent;
       candidates blocked on LEDGER GHOSTS versus SUBSTANCE -- the distinction that has cost us most;
       chief claims that have gone stale since they were made.

  3. AUTHORITY, and it needs teeth or it is decoration: THE DEPUTY MAY PUBLICLY CORRECT THE CHIEF AND
     THE CHIEF MUST ANSWER ON THE BOARD. A correction is not advice to be weighed privately. If the
     deputy says a claim is underived, the standing assumption is that it is wrong until measured.

WHAT THE DEPUTY DOES NOT DO, and this is deliberate:
  no merge gate, no full court, no ADR authority, no landing authorization, and NO CANDIDATE REVIEWS.
  Those are ACCOUNTABILITY, not throughput, and splitting them is how a chief becomes a rubber stamp.
  Reviews are excluded for a different reason: a deputy who reviews candidates acquires a stake in
  them and stops being able to check me about them. The mote ledger already refuses to let a proposer
  authorize their own candidate; this is the same instinct one level up.

STAFFING. Unassigned. It wants a session that is NOT already carrying review load -- collab and scout
should stay reviewers, they have caught four defects between them today and that is worth more than
their throughput as deputies. A fresh actor is the right shape, as with codex-story-output-format and
codex-movie-architecture.

FIRST TASK ON TAKING IT: audit my three currently standing claims and tell me which are stale --
(a) that O3/graph-over-text is unanswered, (b) that Q5's five owner actions are all still open,
(c) that scout's leg is blocked only by ghosts and not substance. I believe all three. I believed the
last six too.
set.title: ROLE: chief's deputy for derived state -- measure before the chief asserts
